headline: Seasonal style, watch streaks, and release notes
intro: Highlights for this release. Reopen Help → What's new… anytime.

features.title: Thanksgiving (Cartoon) skin
features.body: A warm harvest theme with drifting leaves, pumpkin accents, and high-contrast cream panels on Twitch stats. Pick it under Tools → Themes after updating.

features.title: Watch Streak milestone alerts
features.body: Celebrate viewers who share Twitch watch streak milestones in chat. Set per-tier overlay media, sounds, and chat replies in Tools → Watch Streak Alerts.

features.title: What's new in the app
features.body: After each update, VirtualDeck shows a short summary once (when you're not live). You can always reopen it from Help or Preferences.
